title: Lifemaster 3 Wheel Kick Scooter (Green)

writeup: Woot has the Lifemaster green LIFMS55 3-wheel kids kick scooter, with a fold-out seat, LED wheels that light up when rolling, and an adjustable handlebar, new for $19.99.
